positions.title: Angular Developer at Bank of America from FDM Group
positions.locationName: Jersey City, New Jersey, United States
positions.description:
• Contributed to the development of an internal forecasting application using Angular for the front end.
• Utilized ag-grid to effectively add data to grids and Highcharts for graphical data.
• Added several key features to the data grids and related functionality to better serve the users’ needs.
• Created components and view for administrator users.
• Created several experimental features and prototypes, of which some were built upon and/or used as fully fledged features.

positions.title: Angular Developer at Bank of America from FDM Group
positions.locationName: New York, New York, United States
positions.description:
• Contributed to the development of an internal banking CRM application using Angular for the front end.
• Helped integrate ElasticSearch with the UI for custom search by users.
• Built several reusable components for ease of development and code maintainability.
• Worked with designers and product owners to ensure that deliverables were according to specifications.
• Led discussions into project improvement, including code maintainability and UI/UX responsiveness.
• Took part in monthly deployment of the application with Ansible Tower.

positions.title: Web Development Immersive | Engineering Fellow
positions.description:
In my time at GA, I learned not only web dev but also how to code . I constructed four projects based on both established and new technologies such as HTML/CSS/JS, node, and React. Working both alone and in a team, I learned how to work under pressure, communicate and collaborate effectively with teammates, and organize my workload to deliver a finished product. This was a high paced 12 week program that really gave me confidence and skills to learn.

● First project involved front end technologies such as HTML, CSS, and ES6/jQuery
● Second project focused on the back end with node.js, express, and ejs while running a local server and using a third party API
● Third project tied front end and back end by combining a node back end with React front end
● Fourth project used Firebase for the backend and a React front end using the Web Audio API to manipulate music

DJ App
● App made to emulate the functionality of a DJ controller
● Manipulate music using the Web Audio API and changing parameters of different filters to add effects
● React front end for client-side rendering tied to Firebase back end to save user data

positions.title: Shipping and QC Manager
positions.description:
• In charge of all shipping and quality control operations.
• Responsible for accuracy in shipping quantities and checking quality of products and descriptions.
• Implemented organization and communication skills in directing and instructing coworkers.
• Implemented new inventory system in limited time and instructed coworkers on proper usage and adherence to new rules.

positions.title: Shipping Specialist
positions.description:
• Created and completed all shipping orders.
• Overview of all small package and freight/Hazmat shipping orders as well as lay down new shipping guidelines.
• Attention to detail to ensure shipping information is correct and all shipping guidelines/rules met.
• Implementation of freight shipping incorporated and proper Hazmat shipping procedures.

positions.title: Packing Specialist
positions.description:
• Directed team of packagers and ensured correct packing guidelines followed.
• In charge of complex orders and training new workers as well as maintaining quality of packing and worker productivity.
• Leadership in ordering workers effectively to complete orders.
• Communication between management and coworkers solved by becoming bilingual liaison.
